mapper.select: INSERT INTO language_detections (content_variant_id, detected_language, confidence, detector, content_hash) VALUES (#{contentVariantId,typeHandler=com.narrativex.backend.feature.generation.infrastructure.persistence.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler}, #{detectedLanguage}, #{confidence}, #{detector}, #{contentHash}) ON CONFLICT (content_variant_id, content_hash, detector) DO NOTHING RETURNING id
